title: BatchItem
x-spicrawl-endpoint: One element of items[] in a batch body
description:
One URL of a batch: a /v1/scrape request object (every BatchScrapeParams field plus `url`) and an optional
`external_id`. Fields set here override the job-level value for this item only. Unknown fields are a 400.
Run controls (`concurrency`, `priority`, etc.) are not accepted on an item.

allOf.description:
The /v1/scrape request object as accepted by batch, minus `url`. Field names, types and validation are exactly
ScrapeRequest's (enforced by a parity test); each property below references it. Every item is merged as
job-level value, overridden by the item's value (an explicit `false` on an item wins), with the project's
dashboard defaults underneath both. Validation happens for every item at submission.

What the batch worker executes: each item is one fetch or one render, and the document is returned as
`response_format` (`html` by default, `json`, `markdown` or `text`). A field is either honoured on a batch item
or refused at submission, never accepted and skipped. Refused with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER, naming every offending
field, with nothing queued or charged: `actions`, `screenshot` and its options, `network_capture`, `extract`,
`extract_preset`, `ai_extract`, `autoparse`, `links`, `session_id`, `cache`/`cache_ttl`, `original_status`,
`allowed_status_codes`, `parse_pdf=true`, `mode=auto`, `response_format=pdf`, and a non-GET `method` with
`js_render` or `stealth`. A value that asks for nothing (`screenshot: false`, an empty list) is accepted. A
refusal caused by a project default says so in `detail`. Use /v1/scrape for those fields.

A batch item is priced when it is accepted, so a bot challenge never climbs it to camoufox or retries it on a
different exit the way it can a /v1/scrape request with `premium_proxy` or `proxy`.

method.description: Honoured on fetched items. A method other than GET with `js_render` or `stealth` is refused with 400, because a browser navigation is always a GET.

js_render.description: Render the page with the obscura browser engine. Honoured by the batch worker. Default false (or the project default).

stealth.description: Coming soon. Render with the camoufox anti-detection engine; takes precedence over `js_render`. Honoured by the batch worker. Default false (or the project default).

impersonate.description: Applied by the batch worker on fetched items. Default true, as on /v1/scrape; false on the item, the job or the project defaults opts out.

mode.description: `auto` is refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER, also when it comes from the project defaults; the batch worker does not escalate. It runs the engine that `engine`, `js_render` or `stealth` selects.

engine.description:
Engine `camoufox` is coming soon.
Engine pin. On batch only `fetch`, `obscura`, `camoufox` are allowed; `chromium` is rejected with 400
INVALID_PARAMETER (use /v1/scrape for chromium). Also 400 INCOMPATIBLE_FLAGS for: `mode=auto` plus any pin;
`stealth=true` with a pin other than camoufox; `js_render=true` with `fetch`; `screenshot=true` with `fetch`
or `obscura`. A pin the plan does not include is 403 (plans whose entitlements cannot be read allow only
fetch and obscura). To be sure the worker renders, set `js_render` (obscura) or `stealth` (camoufox) rather
than relying on the pin alone.

premium_proxy.description: Coming soon. Use the residential proxy pool instead of datacenter. Honoured by the batch worker; ignored when `proxy` is set.

proxy_country.description: Coming soon. Exit country for pool proxies. Honoured by the batch worker.

proxy.description: Your own proxy URL; wins over the pool flags. Honoured by the batch worker.

proxy_verify.description: Honoured by the batch worker: the custom proxy is probed before the engine cost is spent.

session_id.description: Batch items do not run inside a session. Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

sticky_key.description: Coming soon. Honoured by the batch worker: equal keys are pinned to the same pool exit.

items.description: One workflow step: an object with exactly one verb key plus optional label/timeout_ms/on_error. Two verb keys, or an unknown verb, is 400 ERR::REQUEST::INVALID_PARAMETER before anything is spent.

actions.description: The batch worker does not run browser actions. A non-empty list is refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

block_resources.description: Resource classes to block while rendering. Honoured on rendered items only; unset blocks images and fonts, `none` blocks nothing, a list replaces the default. Falls back to the project default when unset.

headless.description: Honoured on rendered items (the project default for headless is NOT merged on batch).

screenshot.description: The batch worker returns no screenshot. `true` is refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

screenshot_fullpage.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

screenshot_selector.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

screenshot_format.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

screenshot_quality.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

custom_headers.description: Honoured by the batch worker on every item. Falls back to the project default when unset.

autoparse.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

links.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape. Also refused when it comes from the project defaults, and `detail` says so.

allOf.description: Filters for recording the responses the page fetched. Browser-only.

urls.description: Substring matches, or anchored regexes when starting with `^`; empty captures every response of the selected types.

resource_types.description: Resource types to record (exact singular names; no aliases). Unknown values are 400.

include_bodies.description: Include response bodies; false returns url/status/type/timing only, far smaller.

max_body_bytes.description: Per-response body cap in bytes; 0 = default. Larger bodies are truncated and flagged body_truncated.

network_capture.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

allOf.description: Selector map or JSON Schema form. An empty object is 400. Refused on PDF targets (502 ERR::EXTRACT::FAILED).

anyOf.description: JSON Schema form, chosen when `type` is "object" and `properties` is an object. Every property (or its items/nested properties) needs a `selector`; values are coerced to the declared types and validated.

additionalProperties.description: JSON Schema property plus a `selector` keyword.

strict.description: Passed to the extractor to enforce the schema strictly.

anyOf.description: Field name -> selector string or rule. A string may end in `@attr` (e.g. `a.next@href`) to return that attribute. 1-100 fields per level.

oneOf.description: One extraction rule. Unrecognised keys are ignored.

kind.description: `item` returns the first match, `list` all matches.

attribute.description: Attribute name; required when output=attr and forbidden otherwise.

nested.description: Rules evaluated inside each match; requires output html or outer_html. Max nesting depth 5.

extract.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

extract_preset.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

allOf.description: Exactly one of `prompt` or `schema` (both is 400 INCOMPATIBLE_FLAGS, neither is 400 INVALID_PARAMETER). The model reads the page as cleaned markdown; output lands in `data`. +4 credits.

prompt.description: Plain-language description of the data to extract.

schema.description: JSON Schema the output must follow.

ai_extract.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

main_content_only.description: Honoured on `markdown` and `text` items. Unset means off. Falls back to the project default when unset.

parse_pdf.description: The batch worker has no PDF parser. `true` is refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape. `false` is accepted.

response_format.description: Honoured. `html` (the default) and `json` return the document as retrieved; `markdown` and `text` run the same conversion as /v1/scrape. A document that is not HTML (a PDF, an image, JSON) fails a `markdown` or `text` item with EXTRACTION_FAILED; request `html` to get it as retrieved. `pdf` is refused with 400, also when it comes from the project defaults.

cache.description: Batch never reads from the result cache. `true` is refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

cache_ttl.description: A non-zero value is refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape.

max_cost.description: Per-ITEM credit ceiling, checked at submission against the item's dearest outcome (400 if exceeded). For a ceiling on the whole run use `credit_budget`.

original_status.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape. Result lines always carry the target status in `http_status`.

allowed_status_codes.description: Refused on batch with 400 INVALID_PARAMETER (nothing queued or charged); use /v1/scrape. Billing is fixed to target statuses 200, 404 and 410.

url.description: The target URL for this item, validated exactly as /v1/scrape's `url` (http/https, SSRF and blocklist checks). Stored up to 8,192 characters.

external_id.description: Your correlation id, echoed verbatim on this item's result line and never sent to the target. Trimmed of whitespace; empty means none. Not required to be unique.

ScrapeExtractSelectorMap.description: Field name -> selector string or rule. A string may end in `@attr` (e.g. `a.next@href`) to return that attribute. 1-100 fields per level.

oneOf.description: One extraction rule. Unrecognised keys are ignored.

kind.description: `item` returns the first match, `list` all matches.

attribute.description: Attribute name; required when output=attr and forbidden otherwise.

nested.description: Rules evaluated inside each match; requires output html or outer_html. Max nesting depth 5.
